## Global flags

| Flag           | Meaning                                                                      |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--profile`    | Profile to use                                                               |
| `--region`     | Region to use                                                                |
| `--project-id` | Project ID to use                                                            |
| `--output`     | `json`, `table`, or `text`; default from the profile's `output`, else `json` |
| `--query`      | JMESPath expression to filter output                                         |
| `--yes`        | Confirm a destructive operation                                              |
| `--debug`      | Log requests to stderr                                                       |
| `--read-only`  | Refuse every write command                                                   |

## --cli-input-json

Operations accept an inline JSON object or `file://` followed by a local path,
unless the operation disables input JSON. Keys use exact, case-sensitive Go
input field names. Explicit flags override JSON. Unknown fields and trailing
data are errors.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning                                     |
| ---- | ------------------------------------------- |
| 0    | Success                                     |
| 1    | API or network error, or a canceled command |
| 2    | Usage or config error                       |
| 3    | No credentials, login failure, or HTTP 401  |
| 4    | Not found                                   |
